status.title: Status
status.description: waiting = its stage has not opened yet

AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry
AuditEntry.description: One audit row for the status-page timeline (bank values are already masked).

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: Simulated time after the last reset

elapsed_hours.title: Elapsed Hours
elapsed_hours.description: Simulated hours since the last reset

ClockState.title: ClockState
ClockState.description: Simulated clock. All SLA logic uses `now`, never the wall clock.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Set when checking an existing draft; the check is logged

DedupCheckRequest.title: DedupCheckRequest
DedupCheckRequest.description: What the requester has typed so far (debounced on change, and again on submit).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Required for not_duplicate, at least 10 characters (checked by the API with a plain-English message): why this is a different customer/vendor

DedupDecisionIn.title: DedupDecisionIn
DedupDecisionIn.description: The human decision on a duplicate warning. The AI never makes it (rule 6).

block_submit.title: Block Submit
block_submit.description: True for 'likely': submit is blocked until a human links the record or overrides with a reason

body.title: Body
body.description: Bank details are masked unless the acting user is Finance

required.title: Required
required.description: Required form fields (SAP names) for this country, in display order

required_per_selling_country.title: Required Per Selling Country
required_per_selling_country.description: Item only: sub-fields of `registrations` required for each regulated selling country when U_IVD = tYES

FormSpec.title: FormSpec
FormSpec.description: Everything the web app needs to render a request form for one domain x country.

questions_for_requester.title: Questions For Requester
questions_for_requester.description: Plain-English questions, one per missing field

dropped_fields.title: Dropped Fields
dropped_fields.description: Keys the model returned without a matching source quote

bank_details_stripped.title: Bank Details Stripped
bank_details_stripped.description: Bank details were removed before any LLM call (rule 5)

injection_suspected.title: Injection Suspected
injection_suspected.description: Flagged for a human; never acted on (rule 7)

needs_review.title: Needs Review
needs_review.description: confidence < 0.6, or the email looks like it is instructing the AI -> human review queue

method.title: Method
method.description: keyword_fallback = AI offline (no cached answer); show the badge

message.title: Message
message.description: Plain English, e.g. 'Reminder: Amy's item request ...'

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: In-app stand-in for Teams/Outlook messages. Created on the simulated clock.

Persona.title: Persona
Persona.description: A seeded demo user. The web app sends the chosen `user_id` in the X-Acting-User header.

source_quote.title: Source Quote
source_quote.description: Exact substring of the email the value came from

QuotedValue.title: QuotedValue
QuotedValue.description:
One extracted field. `key` is an extract key from config/required_fields.yaml
(`name`, `tax_id`, `registration_number_SG`, ...) or an order key (`customer_name`,
`po_number`, `requested_date`).

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain English, shown to the requester

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Contribution to the score (+/-), for tooltips

RelatedRecord.title: RelatedRecord
RelatedRecord.description: A record that looks similar but is NOT a duplicate by rule (C/V twin, other country).

pending_with.title: Pending With
pending_with.description: Names of people the request waits on

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Bank fields are masked unless the actor is Finance

prefill_quotes.title: Prefill Quotes
prefill_quotes.description: Form field -> source quote, when created from an email

allowed_actions.title: Allowed Actions
allowed_actions.description: For the acting user; the backend still enforces them

pending_with.title: Pending With
pending_with.description: Names of people the request waits on

RequestUpdate.title: RequestUpdate
RequestUpdate.description: Partial update of a DRAFT or INFO_REQUESTED request. Every changed field is audited.

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: Rows per table after the reset

sap_mock_reset.title: Sap Mock Reset
sap_mock_reset.description: False if the SAP mock was not reachable
